title: Orbitals
subtitle: Entangled toroidal filament cluster with geometric constellation web
description: Generative fine-art homage to Dominikus Baur (@dominikus). A dense cluster of 54 3D-entangled beaded filament worms coils around a hollow core cavity, framed by high-contrast black slicing orbital tracks, floating satellite orbs, and a delicate proximity-triangulated geometric constellation web on warm off-white archival paper.
